sources.review: Aerial visually inspected: long pale ribbed roof behind Akita Plaza, narrower appendage at north, parking on both sides.
Street View turned from west toward east: exposed timber post/beam frame, knee braces, corrugated shallow-pitch roof, pale cargo container at north end.

Wider aerial inspected: parking ends at straight eastern fence with construction yard beyond. Apron trimmed to estimated x167 eastern edge and z2908 southern lot edge; original roads/pavement excluded.

uncertainty: Support spacing and container length estimated.
Current container and parked vehicles may differ from 2022 image.
remaining: Outside the canopy, original city surface coverage is incomplete; local flat parking apron fills missing regions. It preserves city surfaces via geometric subtraction.
No cadastral parcel outline available; apron extent inferred from aerial parking context.
